values: 一名威严的坦克，能够制定全场角色都需要遵守的秩序。
A formidable tank who can impose an order that everyone on the battlefield must follow.
吾将带着胜利之音归来。
With the sound of triumph, I shall return.
Behold... the sound of the morning sun!
Was it thou that summoned me?
Whatever it is, I will lend thee my aid!
I rejoice. Thy gift lightens my heart.
I trusted thee, and this is how thou dost repay me?
Don't be afraid, just look at me.
美妙的乐章，会飘扬在夜空之上
Soon, the night will be filled with the most beautiful music.
As for food, I've learned over the years not to be greedy.
美妙的乐章，会飘扬在夜空之上
Soon, the night will be filled with the most beautiful music.
What a symphony of pure passion!
I'll go ring the bell for good fortune!
很少有人敢直视顿里尔的眼睛，他不怒自威的气势让人畏惧。
Few people are able to look directly into Dunlingr's eyes. His imposing aura is so intimidating that even Hypogeans flinch at his intense stare.
顿里尔身边常围绕着为了得到他的青睐而竞相表现的人，谁都想成为那个有资格得到他教诲的宠儿。
Dunlingr is often surrounded by people who compete for his favor. All want to be chosen to receive his teachings.
顿里尔梳胡子是个大工程，要准备好香油和松膏，要把胡子有序分成几缕并固定好，要细致地修剪……他不吝惜花在这上面的时间，强者也需偶尔的消遣。

Having a magnificent beard takes work. Dunlingr likes to use sesame oil and pine balm for his facial hair, spreading them in an orderly manner before trimming them carefully. He admits that it's actually a very soothing task.
顿里尔相当厌恶任何把功夫下在诡辩上的人。因此没有人敢在他面前搬弄口舌是非，弄虚作假。
Dunlingr is known to hate deception and subterfuge. Therefore, no one dares make false claims or lie in front of him.
顿里尔厌恶不知所云的靡靡之音，他认为，如果乐章不浩大壮阔，还有何奏响的必要？
Meaningless and over-the-top music is Dunlingr's bane. He believes that there is no use in a piece of music if it isn't grand and majestic.
在战场上，顿里尔的钟声宛若千军万马呼啸而过，令敌人闻风丧胆。
On the battlefield, the thunderous toll of Dunlingr's bell sounds like the charge of a thousand horses, stunning and shocking the enemy.
顿里尔不屑欺瞒和矫饰，矫饰是弱者的特权。
Dunlingr disdains falsehoods and facades. He once said that "facades are the privilege of the weak."
顿里尔无法容忍乐章里存在不和谐的音律，没法细心地对待音符的人，配不上执掌的乐器。

Dunlingr cannot tolerate the existence of disharmonious notes in a piece of music. He believes that those who are not attentive to the pitch and tone of a sound are not worthy of playing an instrument.
顿里尔相信万事万物都如同乐章一样，有其音律。凡是违背音律行事的人，终将自取灭亡。
"Everything in the universe had its own rhythm, just like a piece of music. Anyone who acts against this rhythm will bring about their own destruction." Dunlingr once said this to a student.
顿里尔克制享乐，从不放纵欲望。他认为“强者应该掌控欲望，而不是被欲望掌控”。
Dunlingr always shows restraint and never indulges in his desires. His motto is that "the strong can control desires rather than let their desires control them."
老朋友，这么长时间没见，你没有变啊，依然如此……无趣。
Ah, old friend! It's been ages, and you're still the same—just as dull as ever.
萨基塔里斯 & 顿里尔
Don't be afraid, just look at me.
As for food, I've learned over the years not to be greedy.
What a symphony of pure passion!
I'll go ring the bell for good fortune!
